subject: HEBR
title: Intermediate Modern Hebrew I
scheduleNote: Open to Freshmen. Students that have not taken HEBR 202 must take the Hebrew placement-proficiency examination and consult the Hebrew coordinator prior to registration, or the Hebrew advisor at registration, for assignment to a lecture-discussion section.
info: 5 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: HEBR 202 or equivalent.

sections.sectionText: Provides a comprehensive review of the fundamentals of Hebrew grammar and oral skills, and introduces a new skills in future tense verb conjugation, and communication in reading, writing, listening, and speaking. Additional information: Must not be a fluent/native speaker of Hebrew. This section is offered through the BTAA Course Share Program hosted by the University of Maryland and will be video-conference/Zoom/online taught for participating universities.
